messages:
Alex: Morning — heads-up: acme-inc hit private VPC GPU ceiling in us-west-2. They report long queueing (>2s p50 token generation) and increased 503s from the LB. They want guidance for client-side throttling we can share.

Priya: Ok. TL;DR for customers: 1) enforce per-client concurrency 2) implement rate-limited retries (429 + Retry-After) 3) prefer token-bucket with small burst. I can paste a short config.

Priya: Example token-bucket (suggested):
```
rate_per_gpu: 4 # requests/sec per GPU for gen-heavy models
max_burst: 8
per_client_concurrency: 6
client_backoff: { initial_ms: 100, max_ms: 2000, factor: 2, jitter: true }
```

Ben: Also mention request sizing: large seq-length or batch-size can saturate a slot. Recommend clients add 'x-estimated-tokens' header so we can provide better admission hints.

Alex: Good — acme uses 4xA100s. Any recommended HTTP behavior to surface from our side?

Priya: Yes. Server should return 429 with headers:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 6
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
Retry-After: 3
```
Clients: on 429 -> exponential backoff + small randomized jitter. Avoid immediate retries.

Celia: Infra note: when pool hits capacity ceiling we currently scale down autoscale headroom to preserve latency SLOs; that may increase 429 windows. We should add this doc to private-deploy runbook.

infra-bot: [autoscaler] 1782340200 pool=acme-prod-gpu scaled 6->4 (scale_reason=quota_ceiling_us-west-2) :warning:

Ben: For SDKs we should expose a 'client_throttle' helper implementing a token-bucket + backoff. Sample JS stub:
```
class Throttle {
  constructor(rate, burst) { ... }
  async acquire() { /* wait or throw */ }
}
```

Priya: Also recommend customers configure a soft-queue on the client (max_queue=256) to avoid huge fanout. If queue > 200 -> shed low priority requests (e.g., analytics) first.

Alex: Can we add a short troubleshooting checklist for support?

Priya: Suggested checklist:
- Check console -> 'capacity_ceiling' alert and pool size
- Look at 429 rate from LB
- Correlate large sequences / high batch sizes
- If quota is region-limited, advise smaller model variants or quantized profiles
- Share SDK throttling snippet with customer

Ben: Add cost note: reducing concurrency lowers immediate GPU cost but increases per-token latency; include example tradeoffs.

Celia: I'll PR an MD into sources/docs/private-deploy/ with the snippets and add to runbook.

Alex: Thanks. I'll send acme a one-pager. @Celia can you also drop a short templated email with kernel steps?

Celia: sure — will post a draft here by EOD :thumbsup:

infra-bot: incident-suppression: delayed notifications enabled for pool=acme-prod-gpu until 1782342000
